# EDA of cit-HepTh dataset

```{r imports}

library(tidyverse)
library(igraph)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(kableExtra)

```


```{r loading data}

citations <- read.delim("./data/cit-HepTh.txt.gz", skip = 4, header = FALSE)
dates <- read.delim("./data/cit-HepTh-dates.txt.gz",skip = 1, header = F)

names(citations) <- c("From", "To")
names(dates) <- c("PaperId", "dates")

```


## Basic data structure

```{r null check, echo=FALSE}

sum(is.na(citations$From))
sum(is.na(citations$To))

```



```{r cross listed}
# head(dates, n = 10)

crosslisted_in_dates <- dates %>%
  filter(grepl("^11", PaperId)) %>%
  nrow()

cat("crosslisted in dates: ", crosslisted_in_dates, "\n")

crosslisted_in_citations <- citations %>%
  filter(grepl("^11", From) | grepl("^11", To)) %>%
  nrow()

cat("crosslisted in citations: ", crosslisted_in_citations, "\n")

```

## Stripping 11 from cross reference Paper IDs

```{r}
dates <- dates %>% mutate(PaperId = as.character(PaperId))
citations <- citations %>% mutate(From = as.character(From), To = as.character(To))

dates_normalized <- dates %>% 
  mutate(PaperId = ifelse(nchar(PaperId) == 9 & substr(PaperId, 1, 2) == "11", substr(PaperId, 3, 9), PaperId))

citations_normalized <- citations %>% 
  mutate(
    From = ifelse(nchar(From) == 9 & substr(From, 1, 2) == "11", substr(From, 3, 9), From),
    To = ifelse(nchar(To) == 9 & substr(To, 1, 2) == "11", substr(To, 3, 9), To)
  )

print(dates_normalized %>% filter(nchar(PaperId) == 9) %>% sum())
print(citations_normalized %>% filter(nchar(From) == 9) %>% sum())
print(citations_normalized %>% filter(nchar(To) == 9) %>% sum())
```


```{r}

print(dates_normalized %>% filter(duplicated(PaperId)) %>% head(n = 10))

```

```{r}


dates_clean2 <- dates_normalized %>% filter(PaperId %in% unique(c(citations_normalized$From, citations_normalized$To))) %>%
  distinct(PaperId, .keep_all = TRUE) %>% mutate()


```


```{r}

library(dplyr)

# 1. Force everything to character format to guarantee a fair comparison
edges_nodes <- unique(c(as.character(citations_normalized$From), as.character(citations_normalized$To)))
vertices_nodes <- as.character(dates_clean2$PaperId)

# 2. Find the exact elements in the edges that do NOT exist in your clean vertices list
problem_nodes <- setdiff(edges_nodes, vertices_nodes)

# 3. Print the diagnostic summary
cat("--- TARGETED GRAPH MATCHING DIAGNOSTIC ---\n")
cat("Total unique nodes found in your edge links: ", length(edges_nodes), "\n")
cat("Total unique nodes found in dates_clean2:    ", length(vertices_nodes), "\n")
cat("Number of offending nodes causing the crash:  ", length(problem_nodes), "\n\n")

if(length(problem_nodes) > 0) {
  cat("The first 20 offending IDs are:\n")
  print(head(problem_nodes, 30))
}

```

## Removing duplicate vertices

Not working on cross referenced papers for now, hence the drop is understandable. 

```{r removing duplicates }

dates_clean <- dates_normalized %>%
  distinct(PaperId, .keep_all = TRUE)

citations_clean <- citations_normalized %>% 
  filter(From %in% dates_clean$PaperId & To %in% dates_clean$PaperId)

```


## Degree distribution



```{r basic graph stats}

g <- graph_from_data_frame(citations_normalized, 
                           directed = TRUE, 
                           vertices = dates_clean)

#Basic properties
n_vertices <- vcount(g)
n_edges <- ecount(g)
density <- edge_density(g)
connectivity <- is_connected(g)

#Degree 
in_degree <- degree(g, mode = "in")
out_degree <- degree(g, mode = "out")

in_degree_stats <- list(
  mean = mean(in_degree),
  median = median(in_degree),
  sd = sd(in_degree),
  min = min(in_degree),
  max = max(in_degree),
  q1 = quantile(in_degree, 0.25),
  q3 = quantile(in_degree, 0.75)
)

out_degree_stats <- list(
  mean = mean(out_degree),
  median = median(out_degree),
  sd = sd(out_degree),
  min = min(out_degree),
  max = max(out_degree),
  q1 = quantile(out_degree, 0.25),
  q3 = quantile(out_degree, 0.75)
)

#Top nodes
top_in <- which(in_degree == max(in_degree))
top_out <- which(out_degree == max(out_degree))

#In-degree/Out-degree ratio
deg_ratio <- ifelse(out_degree == 0, in_degree, in_degree/out_degree)

#Betweenness centrality
betweennes_vals <- betweenness(g, directed = TRUE, weights = NA)

#Component Analysis
scc <- components(g, mode = "strong")
scc_size <- scc$csize
scc_nodes <- scc$no

wcc <- components(g, mode = "weak")
wcc_size <- wcc$csize
wcc_nodes <- wcc$no


#Clustering coefficient
clustering_coeff <- transitivity(g, type = "local", isolates = "zero")


```

```{r in-degree distribution}
indegree_distribution <- table(in_degree) / length(in_degree)

mean_deg_in <- round(mean(in_degree), 2)
median_deg_in <- median(in_degree)

indegree_data <- data.frame(
  degree = as.numeric(names(indegree_distribution)),
  frequency = as.numeric(indegree_distribution)
)

ggplot(indegree_data, aes(x = degree, y = frequency)) + 
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) + 
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.2) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean_deg_in, colour = "blue", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_deg_in, colour = "red", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_x_log10() + 
  annotate("text", x = mean_deg_in, y = 0.17,
  label = paste("mean in-degree =", mean_deg_in),
  colour = "blue", hjust = -0.1) +
  annotate("text", x = mean_deg_in, y = 0.20,
  label = paste("median in-degree =", median_deg_in),
  colour = "red", hjust = -0.1) +
  labs(x = "In-Degree Log Scale", y = "Frequency",
  title = "In-Degree Distribution") +
  theme_minimal()


```

```{r hubs}

plot(out_degree, in_degree,
     log = "xy",
     pch = 16,
     col = "steelblue")


# Highlight hubs
hubs <- which(in_degree > quantile(in_degree, 0.95) &
              out_degree > quantile(out_degree, 0.95))
if(length(hubs) > 0) {
  points(out_degree[hubs], in_degree[hubs],
         pch = 16, col = "red", cex = 1.5)
  legend("topleft", c("Regular", "Hub"), col = c("steelblue", "red"), pch = 16)
}
```

## Yearly Slicing 

```{r slicing}


V(g)$year <- as.numeric(substr(V(g)$dates, 1, 4))

yearspan <- 1992:2003

results <- list()

for(current_year in yearspan){
  
  active_nodes <- V(g)[year <= current_year & !is.na(year)]
  
  # louvain checking 
  if(length(active_nodes) < 10) next
  
  sub_g <- induced_subgraph(g, active_nodes)
  sub_g <- simplify(sub_g)
  
  if (ecount(sub_g) < 20) next
  
  undirected_sub_g <- as.undirected(sub_g, mode = "collapse")
  
  louvain_clusters <- cluster_louvain(undirected_sub_g)
  node_memberships <- membership(louvain_clusters)
  
  #OSLOM checking
  
  total_nodes <- vcount(undirected_sub_g)
  bridge_count <- 0
  
  for (node_idx in 1:total_nodes){
    
    local_neighbours <- neighbors(undirected_sub_g, node_idx, mode = "all")
    if(length(local_neighbours) < 3) next
    
    neighbour_comms <- node_memberships[local_neighbours]
    assigned_comms <- node_memberships[node_idx]
    
    internal_links <- sum(neighbour_comms == assigned_comms)
    external_links <- sum(neighbour_comms != assigned_comms)
    
    if(external_links / (internal_links + external_links) < 0.35){
      bridge_count <- bridge_count + 1
    }
    
  }
  
  results[[as.character(current_year)]] <- tibble(
    Snapshot_Year = current_year,
    Cumulative_Nodes = total_nodes,
    Cumulative_Edges = ecount(sub_g),
    Detected_Clusters = length(louvain_clusters),
    Modularity_Score  = modularity(louvain_clusters),
    Bridge_Nodes_Count = bridge_count,
    Pct_Bridge_Nodes   = (bridge_count / total_nodes) * 100
  )
  
}


```


```{r}

kable(results)

```
